name: Qingdeng Wuye
source:
She is the deity of the ancient Illuminator civilization and the most powerful Illuminator in history, the "sun" of the world. It is under her radiance that Illuminators are able to live normal lives. To show respect, Illuminators named the land they reside in after her name.

[spoiler]As a powerful leader, Inlixa Solar might think that she should shoulder every responsibility because she was capable —even if working too hard undermined her health. The extinction of Inlixa's light triggered a catastrophe, the Eternal Night Calamity, followed by the protracted War of Inlixa.[/spoiler]
